## Data and questions

This post uses the player and tournament-result tables for [Red Bull Wololo: Legacy 2022 – Age of Empires IV](https://www.esportsearnings.com/tournaments/56552-red-bull-wololo-legacy-2022-age-of-empires-iv). It asks which countries were represented, what placements their players achieved, and how much prize money they received.

The CSV files are stored in the repository's `data/` directory. The two tables are kept separate until the merge step so that the data relationship remains explicit.

```{python}
#| label: setup-data
#| warning: false

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

player_profiles = pd.read_csv("../../data/player_profiles.csv")
tournament_results = pd.read_csv("../../data/tournament_results.csv")

player_profiles.head()
```

## Joining and summarising the tables

```{python}
#| label: joined-summary

joined_results = tournament_results.merge(player_profiles, on="player_id", validate="one_to_one")
country_summary = (
    joined_results.groupby("country", as_index=False)
    .agg(players=("player_id", "count"), total_prize_usd=("prize_usd", "sum"))
    .sort_values(["players", "total_prize_usd"], ascending=False)
)
placement_by_country = pd.crosstab(
    joined_results["country"],
    joined_results["placement"],
)

print(country_summary.to_string(index=False))
placement_by_country
```

The merged table connects each player to a country, placement, and prize amount. The country summary provides the first answer to the three project questions: representation, placements, and prize money.

## Prize money by country

```{python}
#| label: fig-python-prize-by-country
#| fig-cap: "Prize money awarded to players from each country."

ax = country_summary.plot.bar(
    x="country",
    y="total_prize_usd",
    legend=False,
    rot=75,
    ylabel="Prize money (USD)",
    title="AoE4 prize money by country",
    figsize=(8, 4),
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
